strategy: Apply the Eviscerate bleed effect through multiple trigger sources: Hellion Sting for single targets, Bombardment and Rampage for AoE, and summoned demons (Ae'grom, Hellwyrm) to scale damage. Progress via campaigns or War Plans activities at appropriate difficulty, using tempers/imprints to maintain power scaling.

paragon.note: Under Paragon 200, use a 'Board Rush' to grab multipliers early, then respec. Maxroll shows this build's Paragon board pathing through an interactive planner (D4Planner) rather than as plain text, so the exact board order can't be faithfully scraped - check source_url for the visual layout.
